set.body: Add a distinct planned-sampling job to the existing videoSource build command so admitted annotation intervals can receive actual frame-derived captions and pass the existing strict annotation/video join. Accept explicit native half-open tick intervals and exact stream/input pins. Validate frame boundaries against the actual probe, select first/last and deterministic middle frames, deduplicate the shared sample set, retain the plan and selection receipt, and emit the unchanged checked CaptionPackage v2 without fabricated detector evidence. Preserve point annotations as unavailable; do not invent positive support. Acceptance: exact endpoints, overlap sampling, off-boundary refusal, one-frame/multi-frame sampling, returned-support equality and package replay tests; actual Sherlock A/A+V receipt remains on the journey parent. No ONNX/caption fusion or physical scanner timing claim. Parent coordinates builds and review; worker must not run heavy gates concurrently.
set.title: Support exact annotation intervals in planned video acquisition
